title: JANUS Linear A R3B current L2/L3 editorial-source access recheck

relationship_to_R3_v1_0.purpose: Recheck executable public access after the completed SigLA R3A chain. This artifact updates access status only; it does not upgrade any source's independence level.

access_recheck.name: Recueil des inscriptions en linéaire A — Supplément 1
access_recheck.current_public_access_observation: CNR institutional record exposes bibliographic/abstract metadata. The associated PDF entry is marked private/restricted and offers a request-copy route rather than an open corpus download.
access_recheck.scope_observation: The supplement adds 107 documents and 427 signs, covering material discovered/published after the original GORILA period up to 2023.
access_recheck.methodological_relation: The published description states that the supplement continues the methodological tradition of the original Recueil/GORILA rather than constituting an independently curated L3 legacy transcription baseline.
access_recheck.best_next_access_action: Request scholarly access/copy from the institutional repository or editor, then freeze exact received bytes and provenance before inspecting transcription-level overlap.

access_recheck.name: Testi minoici trascritti
access_recheck.current_public_access_observation: The IULM repository record is bibliographic and currently reports no associated files. Historical Digital Classicist documentation describes an intended EpiDoc/XML online corpus but not a currently verified complete downloadable public dataset.
access_recheck.best_next_access_action: Acquire the print monograph or recover an authoritative TMT digital/EpiDoc dataset; freeze exact edition/source bytes before any comparison.

access_recheck.name: Corpus transnuméré du linéaire A
access_recheck.current_public_access_observation: Current public search exposes bibliographic/catalogue records for the print corpus and scholarly discussion of its readings, not a verified open complete machine-readable transcription dump.
access_recheck.best_next_access_action: Obtain a fixed print/digital scan edition and predeclare a manual overlap-transcription protocol if no authoritative machine-readable representation can be recovered.

R3B_result.why_manual_fallback_is_allowed: A manually produced overlap dataset can become auditable evidence only if document selection, edition identity, transcription grammar, uncertainty handling and blindness are frozen before the readings are transcribed or compared. Manual work does not automatically create source independence; it only makes an alternate editorial source executable.

preconditions_for_any_acquired_source: Freeze exact source edition, bytes/pages and acquisition provenance before content comparison.
Classify source independence separately at digitization, editorial and primary-transcription layers.
Freeze overlap document IDs before reading candidate-specific outcomes.
Preserve source-native uncertainty, punctuation, numeric/fraction and damaged-sign notation rather than coercing it into mwenge or SigLA syntax.
Build a source-specific parser/normalizer and an identity bridge with explicit collision/failure states.
Do not expose prior near-miss identities to a human transcriber if the manual subset is intended as a blinded replication gate.

next_gate.goal: Before transcription-level inspection, freeze a deterministic overlap subset and source-native transcription protocol for RILA-S1, CTLA or TMT material whose exact edition/pages have been acquired.
next_gate.parallel_goal: Record exact received/downloaded/scanned source identity, access route, hashes, page coverage and license/usage conditions without making a scientific comparison claim.
